selection: All three already covered routes; common departure permits 15/8/1-day lead checkpoints. Thanksgiving-period convenience sample.
primary_target: Difference in current price_insights.lowest_price between actual retrieval snapshots; not reconstructed history
training: None: no fitted model and no selection using pilot outcomes
missed_window: Skip and record missing; never backfill a prospective price from returned history
evaluation: First interval is a pipeline check. Final interval remains unopened until final evaluation; baseline is fixed now. Same three trip groups: no group-held-out or broad generalization claim.
